profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I currently work as a full-stack web developer, maintaining production systems, and rebuilding legacy sites with modern technology and design.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Over my tenure with L-3, I've done an array of things: from database development and ASP.net, to life cycle development and in-depth documentation.  

The majority of my time has been dedicated to web application maintenance and development.  I have a large amount of experience with Oracle and MS SQL Server development and maintenance.  While tasked with those, I have also developed front-end code in ASP.net (C#), designed and laid out pages using HTML and CSS, and have integrated Javascript and AJAX controls.

Recently I was tasked with planning the restructuring and upgrade of our current web application for mobile browsers (specifically the iPad).  This also included the planning and coding of web services for a future native iPad application.

Apart from work duties I have also personally studied and dabbled in jQuery, Ruby on Rails, HTML5 and AJAX technologies.

projects.title: VDRP - Voluntary Disclosure Reporting Program
projects.description: VDRP is a web application that allows airlines to self-report certain FAA violations, to better mitigate risk and improve safety.  While working on VDRP, I have handled customer tickets, developed code, fixed existing code and have planned future steps for VDRP's improvement.  Currently, I am the sole programmer on the project, tasked primarily with maintaining the application, while planning, developing and implementing required improvements.

projects.title: SOAR - System of Airports Reporting
projects.description: SOAR is a finance and planning application that deals with airport improvement.  On the project, I worked on database maintenance, maintained the ticketing system, servicing tickets, and worked with the customer closely to resolve bugs, tickets and gather requirements.
